Demo Store Return Policy

Return window
Most items can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund to the original payment method. Items must be unused, in original packaging, with all accessories.

Clearance and discounted items
Items marked as clearance are final sale and cannot be returned or exchanged. Items bought with a regular promotional discount follow the standard return window.

Refund timing
Refunds are issued within 5 business days after the returned item is inspected at our warehouse.

Non-returnable items
Gift cards, downloadable software and personal care items that have been opened cannot be returned.
